mapper.select: /*상담유형 콤보*/ SELECT /*SQL-ID :isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper." : selectType1Comb */ CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS TYPE1VALUE , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TYPE1NM /*상담통계유형*/ FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MM_DSCSN_STATS_TYPE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('05','11','24')

/*상담영역 콤보*/ SELECT /*SQL-ID :isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper." : selectType2Comb */ CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS TYPE2VALUE , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TYPE2NM /*상담영역*/ FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD'
mapper.sql:
/*게시글유형(type1=전체) 게시글+채팅 */ WITH YE10 AS( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ FROM AYE100 /*게시글*/ WHERE AYE100.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분(비밀,공개)*/
IN (CASE WHEN AYE100.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE('20200916','YYYYMMDD') THEN '06' ELSE '05' END , '11' , '24' )
IN (CASE WHEN AYE100.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE('20200916','YYYYMMDD') THEN '06' ELSE '05' END )
IN (#{type1} )
AND AYE100.DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD LIKE #{type2} /*상담영역구분(가족,비행~)*/ AND AYE100.SXDC_SE_CD LIKE #{gender} /*성별*/ /*회원 선택 */
AND EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' /*회원*/ FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR ENFSN_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID )
/*비회원 선택*/
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' /*비회원*/ FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR ENFSN_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID )
AND AYE100.DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 ) , YB20 AS( SELECT CHRO_NO /*채팅방번호*/ FROM AYB200 /*채팅이력*/ WHERE AYB200.SXDC_SE_CD LIKE #{gender} /*성별*/ /*회원을 선택한 경우*/
AND EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' /*회원*/ FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID OR ENFSN_NO = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID OR YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID )
/*비회원을 선택한 경우*/
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' /*비회원*/ FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID OR ENFSN_NO = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID OR YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID )
AND AYB200.DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 ) , YE15 AS( SELECT AYE195.MSRMT_SCORE AS SCORE , AYE195.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN FROM AYE195 /*상담글평가*/ , YE10 WHERE AYE195.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = YE10.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ AND AYE195.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = YE10.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND AYE195.DEL_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT AYE195.MSRMT_SCORE AS SCORE , AYE195.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN FROM AYE195 /*상담글평가*/ , YB20 WHERE AYE195.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = YB20.CHRO_NO /*채팅방번호*/ AND AYE195.DEL_YN = 'N' )

/*게시글 영역별 data WITH구문*/ WITH YE10 AS( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ FROM AYE100 /*게시글*/ WHERE AYE100.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분(비밀,공개)*/
IN (CASE WHEN AYE100.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE('20200916','YYYYMMDD') THEN '06' ELSE '05' END , '11' , '24' )
IN (CASE WHEN AYE100.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE('20200916','YYYYMMDD') THEN '06' ELSE '05' END )
IN (#{type1} )
AND AYE100.DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD LIKE #{type2} /*상담영역구분(가족,비행~)*/
AND AYE100.SXDC_SE_CD LIKE #{gender} /*성별*/
/*회원 선택 */
AND EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' /*회원*/ FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR ENFSN_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID )
/*비회원 선택*/
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' /*비회원*/ FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR ENFSN_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID OR YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID )
AND AYE100.DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 ) , YE15 AS( SELECT AYE195.MSRMT_SCORE AS SCORE , AYE195.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN FROM AYE195 /*상담글평가*/ , YE10 WHERE AYE195.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = YE10.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ AND AYE195.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = YE10.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND AYE195.DEL_YN = 'N' )
mapper.select: /* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSrvyExmnStatsList1 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CASE WHEN NCNT != 0 THEN ROUND((NCNT / TCNT) * 100,2) ELSE 0 END AS NPER ,CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ,NCNT AS NCNT FROM ( SELECT A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ,A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE SITE_ACCES_TYPE_SE_CD = A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS NCNT ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS TCNT FROM SAC100 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SITE_ACCES_TYPE_SE_CD' )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSrvyExmnStatsList2 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT CASE WHEN AREA != '해외거주' THEN '국내거주' ELSE AREA END AS LOC ,AREA AS AREA ,NCNT AS NCNT ,CASE WHEN NCNT > 0 THEN ROUND((NCNT / TCNT) * 100,2) ELSE 0 END AS NPER FROM ( SELECT NVL((SELECT CTPV_NM FROM SAA020 WHERE CTPV_SE_CD = A.CTPV_SE_CD AND rownum < 2), '해외거주') AS AREA ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE SGG_CD LIKE A.CTPV_SE_CD||'%' AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS NCNT , (SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS TCNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT (LPAD(SGG_CD,2)) AS CTPV_SE_CD FROM AYA210 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) A )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSrvyExmnStatsList3 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CASE WHEN NCNT > 0 THEN ROUND((NCNT / TCNT) * 100,2) ELSE 0 END AS NPER ,CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ,NCNT AS NCNT FROM ( SELECT A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ,A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE DSCSN_EXPRNC_SE_CD = A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS NCNT ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS TCNT FROM SAC100 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'DSCSN_EXPRNC_SE_CD' )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSrvyExmnStatsList4 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT MCNT AS MCNT ,FCNT AS FCNT ,'남' AS MAN ,'여' AS WOMAN ,XCNT AS XCNT ,SUM_CNT AS SUM_CNT ,CASE WHEN MCNT > 0 THEN ROUND((MCNT / SUM_CNT) * 100,2) ELSE 0 END AS NPERM ,CASE WHEN FCNT > 0 THEN ROUND((FCNT / SUM_CNT) * 100,2) ELSE 0 END AS NPERF FROM ( SELECT (SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS MCNT ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS FCNT ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE SXDC_SE_CD = 'X' AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS XCNT ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS SUM_CNT FROM DUAL )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSrvyExmnStatsList5 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CASE WHEN NCNT > 0 THEN ROUND((NCNT / TCNT) * 100,2) ELSE 0 END AS NPER ,CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ,NCNT AS NCNT FROM ( SELECT A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ,A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE SRVY_RSPDNT_TRGT_SE_CD = A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS NCNT ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYA210 WHERE WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS TCNT FROM SAC100 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVY_RSPDNT_TRGT_SE_CD' )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectCnctDgstfnStatsList - 응용2팀 정원제 */ SELECT
CASE WHEN NO < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS GROUP_NO
1 AS GROUP_NO
, NO , DGSTFN_QESITM , CNT1 + CNT2 + CNT3 + CNT4 + CNT5 AS TOT_CNT , CNT1 , CNT2 , CNT3 , CNT4 , CNT5 , CASE WHEN (CNT1 + CNT2 + CNT3 + CNT4 + CNT5) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR((CNT1 + CNT2*2 + CNT3*3 + CNT4*4 + CNT5*5) / (CNT1 + CNT2 + CNT3 + CNT4 + CNT5)) END AVRG FROM ( SELECT B.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AS NO , B.QESITM_CN AS DGSTFN_QESITM , SUM(CASE WHEN B.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT1 , SUM(CASE WHEN B.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT2 , SUM(CASE WHEN B.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT3 , SUM(CASE WHEN B.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT4 , SUM(CASE WHEN B.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT5 FROM AYE100 A , AYE260 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND A.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = #{CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD} /* 이음게시판카테고리구분코드*/ AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND B.OBJCT_ANS_CN IS NOT NULL
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY B.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO, B.QESITM_CN ) ORDER BY NO ASC

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectCnctDgstfnStatsList1 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ,QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN ,SCORE1 AS SCORE1 ,SCORE2 AS SCORE2 ,SCORE3 AS SCORE3 ,SCORE4 AS SCORE4 ,SCORE5 AS SCORE5 ,OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN ,TOTAL_VOCS AS TOTAL_VOCS ,(SCORE1+SCORE2+SCORE3+SCORE4+SCORE5) / 5 AS AVRG FROM( SELECT a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 ,c.QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN --문항내용 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '1' ) AS SCORE1 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '2' ) AS SCORE2 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '3' ) AS SCORE3 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '4' ) AS SCORE4 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '5' ) AS SCORE5 ,c.OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN --객관식답변내용 --점수는패스 , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS TOTAL_VOCS -- 총 건수 FROM AYE100 a /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,SAC100 b /* 공통코드 값 */ ,AYE260 c /* 게시판_eum_만족도조사답변 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = b.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND a.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = '01' --01:자녀와 함께 성장하는 부모 AND b.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' AND c.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectCnctDgstfnStatsList2 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ,QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN ,SCORE1 AS SCORE1 ,SCORE2 AS SCORE2 ,SCORE3 AS SCORE3 ,SCORE4 AS SCORE4 ,SCORE5 AS SCORE5 ,OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN ,TOTAL_VOCS AS TOTAL_VOCS ,(SCORE1+SCORE2+SCORE3+SCORE4+SCORE5) / 5 AS AVRG FROM( SELECT a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 ,c.QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN --문항내용 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '1' ) AS SCORE1 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '2' ) AS SCORE2 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '3' ) AS SCORE3 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '4' ) AS SCORE4 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '5' ) AS SCORE5 ,c.OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN --객관식답변내용 --점수는패스 , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS TOTAL_VOCS -- 총 건수 FROM AYE100 a /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,SAC100 b /* 공통코드 값 */ ,AYE260 c /* 게시판_eum_만족도조사답변 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = b.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND a.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = '02' --02:학교푝력예방 AND b.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' AND c.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectCnctDgstfnStatsList3 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ,QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN ,SCORE1 AS SCORE1 ,SCORE2 AS SCORE2 ,SCORE3 AS SCORE3 ,SCORE4 AS SCORE4 ,SCORE5 AS SCORE5 ,OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN ,TOTAL_VOCS AS TOTAL_VOCS ,(SCORE1+SCORE2+SCORE3+SCORE4+SCORE5) / 5 AS AVRG FROM( SELECT a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 ,c.QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN --문항내용 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '1' ) AS SCORE1 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '2' ) AS SCORE2 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '3' ) AS SCORE3 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '4' ) AS SCORE4 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '5' ) AS SCORE5 ,c.OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN --객관식답변내용 --점수는패스 , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS TOTAL_VOCS -- 총 건수 FROM AYE100 a /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,SAC100 b /* 공통코드 값 */ ,AYE260 c /* 게시판_eum_만족도조사답변 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = b.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND a.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = '03' --03:다문화가족 AND b.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' AND c.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectCnctDgstfnStatsList4 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ,QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN ,SCORE1 AS SCORE1 ,SCORE2 AS SCORE2 ,SCORE3 AS SCORE3 ,SCORE4 AS SCORE4 ,SCORE5 AS SCORE5 ,OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN ,TOTAL_VOCS AS TOTAL_VOCS ,(SCORE1+SCORE2+SCORE3+SCORE4+SCORE5) / 5 AS AVRG FROM( SELECT a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD AS CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 ,c.QESITM_CN AS QESITM_CN --문항내용 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '1' ) AS SCORE1 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '2' ) AS SCORE2 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '3' ) AS SCORE3 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '4' ) AS SCORE4 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE260 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = c.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND x.OBJCT_ANS_CN = '5' ) AS SCORE5 ,c.OBJCT_ANS_CN AS OBJCT_ANS_CN --객관식답변내용 --점수는패스 , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS TOTAL_VOCS -- 총 건수 FROM AYE100 a /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,SAC100 b /* 공통코드 값 */ ,AYE260 c /* 게시판_eum_만족도조사답변 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = b.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND a.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = c.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = c.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND a.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD = '04' --04:이혼가족 부모교육 AND b.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD' --이음게시판카테고리구분코드 AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' AND c.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} )

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectCnctChngList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT AA.FLAG FLAG,
CASE WHEN AA.FLAG = '사전' AND BB.CNT11 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM11 / BB.CNT11,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '사후' AND BB.CNT21 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM21 / BB.CNT21,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '변화도' AND BB.CNT11 > 0 AND BB.CNT21 > 0 THEN ROUND(((BB.SUM21 / BB.CNT21) - (BB.SUM11 / BB.CNT11)) * 100 / (BB.SUM11 / BB.CNT11),0) ELSE 0 END AVER1, CASE WHEN AA.FLAG = '사전' AND BB.CNT12 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM12 / BB.CNT12 ,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '사후' AND BB.CNT22 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM22 / BB.CNT22,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '변화도' AND BB.CNT12 > 0 AND BB.CNT22 > 0 AND BB.SUM12 > 0 THEN ROUND(((BB.SUM22 / BB.CNT22) - (BB.SUM12 / BB.CNT12)) * 100 / (BB.SUM12 / BB.CNT12),0) ELSE 0 END AVER2, CASE WHEN AA.FLAG = '사전' AND BB.CNT13 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM13 / BB.CNT13 ,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '사후' AND BB.CNT23 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM23 / BB.CNT23,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '변화도' AND BB.CNT13 > 0 AND BB.CNT23 > 0 AND BB.SUM13 > 0 THEN ROUND(((BB.SUM23 / BB.CNT23) - (BB.SUM13 / BB.CNT13)) * 100 / (BB.SUM13 / BB.CNT13),0) ELSE 0 END AVER3, CASE WHEN AA.FLAG = '사전' AND BB.CNT14 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM14 / BB.CNT14,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '사후' AND BB.CNT24 > 0 THEN ROUND(BB.SUM24 / BB.CNT24,0) WHEN AA.FLAG = '변화도' AND BB.CNT14 > 0 AND BB.CNT24 > 0 AND BB.SUM14 > 0 THEN ROUND(((BB.SUM24 / BB.CNT24) - (BB.SUM14 / BB.CNT14)) * 100 / (BB.SUM14 / BB.CNT14),0) ELSE 0 END AVER4
FROM ( SELECT FLAG FROM ( SELECT '사전' FLAG FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '사후' FLAG FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '변화도' FLAG FROM DUAL ) ) AA, ( SELECT NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '01' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM11, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT11, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '02' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM12, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT12, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '03' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM13, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT13, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '04' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM14, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '0' AND CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT14, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '01' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM21, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT21, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '02' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM22, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT22, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '03' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM23, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT23, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '04' THEN SUM1 ELSE 0 END ),0) SUM24, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN FLAG = '1' AND CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) CNT24 FROM ( SELECT B.FLAG_YN FLAG, A.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD CD, SUM(B.ANS_CN) SUM1, COUNT(*) CNT1 FROM AYE100 A , AYE250 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{bbscttTypeSeCd} AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.ANS_CN IS NOT NULL AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO,B.FLAG_YN, A.CNCT_NTABRD_CTGRYB_SE_CD ) ) BB

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSlrbyDscsnStatsList1 - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT AA.CD AS CD, AA.NM AS NM, NVL(BB.CNT1, 0) AS CNT1, /* 실시건수(합계) */ NVL(BB.CNT11,0) AS CNT11, /* 실시건수(M) */ NVL(BB.CNT12,0) AS CNT12, /* 실시건수(F) */ NVL(BB.CNT2, 0) AS CNT2, /* 게시판건수(합계) */ NVL(BB.CNT21,0) AS CNT21, /* 게시판건수(M) */ NVL(BB.CNT22,0) AS CNT22, /* 게시판건수(F) */ NVL(CC.CNT3, 0) AS CNT3, /* 게시판답변(합계) */ NVL(CC.CNT31,0) AS CNT31, /* 게시판답변(M) */ NVL(CC.CNT32,0) AS CNT32, /* 게시판답변(F) */ NVL(DD.CNT4, 0) AS CNT4, /* 댓글(합계) */ NVL(DD.CNT41,0) AS CNT41, /* 댓글(M) */ NVL(DD.CNT42,0) AS CNT42 /* 댓글(F) */ FROM ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE CD, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD'
AND UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE < '100' AND USE_YN = 'Y'
) AA, ( SELECT SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD CD, SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT11, /* 실시건수(M) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT12, /* 실시건수(F) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT1, /* 실시건수(합계) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT21, /* 게시판건수(M) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT22, /* 게시판건수(F) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT2 /* 게시판건수(합계) */ FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01','02') /* 솔로봇게시판, 솔로봇채팅 */ AND SLRBT_DSCSN_LCLAS_SE_CD = 'game' /* 게임 */ AND DEL_YN = 'N'
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD ) BB, ( SELECT A.SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD CD, SUM(CASE WHEN A.SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT31, /* 게시판답변(M) */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT32, /* 게시판답변(F) */ COUNT(*) CNT3 /* 게시판답변(합계) */ FROM AYE100 A, AYE120 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' /* 솔로봇게시판:01 */ AND A.SLRBT_DSCSN_LCLAS_SE_CD = 'game' /* 게임 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY A.SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD ) CC, ( SELECT A.SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD CD, SUM(CASE WHEN A.SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT41, /* 댓글(M) */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT42, /* 댓글(F) */ COUNT(*) CNT4 /* 댓글(합계) */ FROM AYE100 A , AYE110 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 솔로봇채팅:02 */ AND A.SLRBT_DSCSN_LCLAS_SE_CD = 'game' /* 게임 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD ) DD WHERE AA.CD = BB.CD(+) AND AA.CD = CC.CD(+) AND AA.CD = DD.CD(+) ORDER BY AA.CD ASC

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectSlrbyDscsnStatsList2 - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT AA.CD AS CD, AA.NM AS NM, NVL(BB.CNT1, 0) AS CNT1, /* 실시건수(합계) */ NVL(BB.CNT11,0) AS CNT11, /* 실시건수(재학생) */ NVL(BB.CNT12,0) AS CNT12, /* 실시건수(학교밖,가정밖) */ NVL(BB.CNT2, 0) AS CNT2, /* 게시판건수(합계) */ NVL(BB.CNT21,0) AS CNT21, /* 게시판건수(재학생) */ NVL(BB.CNT22,0) AS CNT22, /* 게시판건수(학교밖,가정밖) */ NVL(CC.CNT3, 0) AS CNT3, /* 게시판답변(합계) */ NVL(CC.CNT31,0) AS CNT31, /* 게시판답변(재학생) */ NVL(CC.CNT32,0) AS CNT32, /* 게시판답변(학교밖,가정밖) */ NVL(DD.CNT4, 0) AS CNT4, /* 댓글(합계) */ NVL(DD.CNT41,0) AS CNT41, /* 댓글(재학생) */ NVL(DD.CNT42,0) AS CNT42 /* 댓글(학교밖,가정밖) */ FROM ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE CD, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD'
AND UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE < '100'
AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AA, ( SELECT SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD CD, SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND YNGBGS_SE_NO = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT11, /* 실시건수(재학생) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND YNGBGS_SE_NO IN ('01','03') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT12, /* 실시건수(학교밖,가정밖) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT1, /* 실시건수(합계) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' AND YNGBGS_SE_NO = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT21, /* 게시판건수(재학생) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' AND YNGBGS_SE_NO IN ('01','03') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT22, /* 게시판건수(학교밖,가정밖) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT2 /* 게시판건수(합계) */ FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01','02') /* 솔로봇게시판, 솔로봇채팅 */ AND SLRBT_DSCSN_LCLAS_SE_CD = 'game' /* 게임 */ AND DEL_YN = 'N'
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD ) BB, ( SELECT A.SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD CD, SUM(CASE WHEN A.YNGBGS_SE_NO = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT31, /* 게시판답변(재학생) */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.YNGBGS_SE_NO IN ('01','03') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT32, /* 게시판답변(학교밖,가정밖) */ COUNT(*) CNT3 /* 게시판답변(합계) */ FROM AYE100 A , AYE120 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' /* 솔로봇게시판:01 */ AND A.SLRBT_DSCSN_LCLAS_SE_CD = 'game' /* 게임 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY A.SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD ) CC, ( SELECT A.SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD CD, SUM(CASE WHEN A.YNGBGS_SE_NO = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT41, /*댓글(재학생) */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.YNGBGS_SE_NO IN ('01','03') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT42, /*댓글(학교밖,가정밖) */ COUNT(*) CNT4 /*댓글(합계) */ FROM AYE100 A , AYE110 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 솔로봇채팅:02 */ AND A.SLRBT_DSCSN_LCLAS_SE_CD = 'game' /* 게임 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY SLRBT_DSCSN_SCLAS_SE_CD ) DD WHERE AA.CD = BB.CD(+) AND AA.CD = CC.CD(+) AND AA.CD = DD.CD(+) ORDER BY AA.CD ASC

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectLinkPrfmncStatsList1 - 응용2팀 김해룡*/ SELECT MAX(AA.CD) AS LINK_ORG, --청소년상담복지센터, 가족, 일시보호소쉼터,긴급구조, 지도자 ,기타전문기관 SUM(CASE WHEN AA.NO = 1 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD11 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 2 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD21 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 3 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD31 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 4 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD41 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 5 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD51 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 6 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD61 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DANGER_DIRECT, --위기(직접연계) SUM(CASE WHEN AA.NO = 1 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD12 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 2 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD22 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 3 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD32 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 4 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD42 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 5 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD52 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 6 AND BB.CD = '위기' AND BB.CD62 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DANGER_SHARE, --위기(정보제공) SUM(CASE WHEN AA.NO = 1 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD11 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 2 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD21 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 3 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD31 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 4 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD41 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 5 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD51 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 6 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD61 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_DIRECT, --일반(직접연계) SUM(CASE WHEN AA.NO = 1 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD12 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 2 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD22 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 3 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD32 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 4 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD42 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 5 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD52 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 6 AND BB.CD = '일반' AND BB.CD62 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_SHARE, --위기(정보제공) SUM(CASE WHEN AA.NO = 1 AND BB.CD11 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 2 AND BB.CD21 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 3 AND BB.CD31 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 4 AND BB.CD41 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 5 AND BB.CD51 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 6 AND BB.CD61 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DIRECT_TOTAL, --합계(직접연계) SUM(CASE WHEN AA.NO = 1 AND BB.CD12 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 2 AND BB.CD22 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 3 AND BB.CD32 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 4 AND BB.CD42 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 5 AND BB.CD52 = 1 THEN 1 WHEN AA.NO = 6 AND BB.CD62 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SHARE_TOTAL --합계(정보제공) FROM (
SELECT ROWNUM NO, DECODE(ROWNUM, 1,'청소년상담복지센터',2,'가족',3,'일시보호소쉼터',4,'긴급구조',5,'지도자',6,'기타전문기관') CD FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 6
) AA, ( SELECT DECODE(CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD, '10','일반','위기') CD, --위기유형구분코드 '10'의 경우에만 일반 DECODE(YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'1',1,0) CD11, --청소년상담복지센터직접연계 DECODE(YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'2',1,0) CD12, --청소년상담복지센터정보제공 DECODE(FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'1',1,0) CD21, --가족직접연계 DECODE(FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'2',1,0) CD22, --가족정보제공 DECODE(DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'1',1,0) CD31, --일시보호소쉼터직접연계 DECODE(DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'2',1,0) CD32, --일시보호소쉼터정보제공 DECODE(EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'1',1,0) CD41, --긴급구조직접연계 DECODE(EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'2',1,0) CD42, --긴급구조정보제공 DECODE(LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'1',1,0) CD51, --지도자직접연계 DECODE(LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'2',1,0) CD52, --지도자정보제공 DECODE(ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'1',1,0) CD61, --기타전문기관직접연계 DECODE(ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD ,'2',1,0) CD62 --기타전문기관정보제공 FROM AYA120 WHERE 1=1

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectWeposInspStatsList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT WEPOS_MLSFC_SN AS WEPOS_MLSFC_SN , SE_NM AS SE_NM , COUNT(USER_ID) AS CNT , '대인관계' AS INSP_SE --검사구분 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,AYE110 y /* 사이버상담댓글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = y.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.TRL_INSP_SN = WEPOS_MLSFC_SN AND y.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' ) AS CMNT --댓글 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,AYE110 y /* 사이버상담댓글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = y.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.TRL_INSP_SN = WEPOS_MLSFC_SN AND y.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'M') AS CMNT_M --댓글 남자 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,AYE110 y /* 사이버상담댓글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = y.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.TRL_INSP_SN = WEPOS_MLSFC_SN AND y.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'F') AS CMNT_F --댓글 여자 FROM ( SELECT c2.WEPOS_MLSFC_SN, c2.SE_NM, kk.USER_ID, kk.EVL_DT FROM AYD310 c2, /* 심리검사카테고리2_asis */ ( SELECT c3.WEPOS_MLSFC_SN, cho.USER_ID, cho.EVL_DT FROM AYD320 c3, AYD330 pat, AYD500 cho WHERE c3.WEPOS_SCLAS_SN = pat.WEPOS_SCLAS_SN AND pat.FLAG_YN = 'Y' AND pat.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO = cho.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO AND cho.EVL_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} )kk WHERE c2.WEPOS_LCLAS_SN = 1 AND c2.WEPOS_MLSFC_SN = kk.WEPOS_MLSFC_SN(+) GROUP BY c2.WEPOS_MLSFC_SN, c2.SE_NM, kk.USER_ID, kk.EVL_DT ) GROUP BY WEPOS_MLSFC_SN, SE_NM

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectWeposInspStatsListSe2 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT D.TRL_INSP_MNG_NO AS WEPOS_MLSFC_SN , D.TRL_INSP_NM AS SE_NM , D.KOGU_PVSN_NO AS KOGU_PVSN_NO , D.CNT AS CNT ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,AYE110 y /* 사이버상담댓글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = y.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.TRL_INSP_SN = TRL_INSP_MNG_NO AND y.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' ) AS CMNT --댓글 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,AYE110 y /* 사이버상담댓글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = y.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.TRL_INSP_SN = TRL_INSP_MNG_NO AND y.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'M') AS CMNT_M --댓글 남자 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE100 x /* 사이버상담게시글 */ ,AYE110 y /* 사이버상담댓글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = y.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND x.TRL_INSP_SN = TRL_INSP_MNG_NO AND y.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'F') AS CMNT_F --댓글 여자 , (SELECT TRL_INSP_SE_NM1 FROM AYD600 AA WHERE AA.TRL_INSP_SN = D.KOGU_PVSN_NO) INSP_SE from (SELECT B.TRL_INSP_MNG_NO, A.TRL_INSP_NM, A.KOGU_PVSN_NO, B.cnt FROM (SELECT TRL_INSP_MNG_NO, TRL_INSP_NM, KOGU_PVSN_NO FROM AYD400) A, (SELECT TRL_INSP_MNG_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TRL_INSP_MNG_NO) B where A.TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = B.TRL_INSP_MNG_NO) D left outer join (SELECT KOGU_PVSN_NO, COUNT(KOGU_PVSN_NO) AS CNT2 FROM AYD400 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY KOGU_PVSN_NO ) C ON D.KOGU_PVSN_NO = C.KOGU_PVSN_NO

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectWeposInspStatsListANGR - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT '차마라 형' AS FCTR, NVL(SUM(a_1),0) AS HA, NVL(SUM(a_2),0) AS SANG, NVL(SUM(a_1),0) + NVL(SUM(a_2),0) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR('a:L', SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,0,3)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END a_1, CASE WHEN INSTR('a:H', SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,0,3)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END a_2 FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = 'ANGR' AND SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,0,1) = 'a' ) A UNION ALL SELECT '벌컥! 형' AS FCTR, NVL(SUM(b_1),0) AS HA, NVL(SUM(b_2),0) AS SANG, NVL(SUM(b_1),0) + NVL(SUM(b_2),0) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR('b:L', SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,5,3)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END b_1, CASE WHEN INSTR('b:H', SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,5,3)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END b_2 FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = 'ANGR' AND SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,5,1) = 'b' ) A UNION ALL SELECT '쯔미야 형' AS FCTR, NVL(SUM(c_1),0) AS HA, NVL(SUM(c_2),0) AS SANG, NVL(SUM(c_1),0) + NVL(SUM(c_2),0) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR('c:L', SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,9,3)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END c_1, CASE WHEN INSTR('c:H', SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,9,3)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END c_2 FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = 'ANGR' AND SUBSTR(WEPOS_RESULT_NM,5,1) = 'c' ) A

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectWeposInspStatsDetailList1 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO , A.WEPOS_PTTRN_NM AS FCTR , SUM(CASE WHEN B.WEPOS_SUM_SCORE <= 39 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HA , SUM(CASE WHEN B.WEPOS_SUM_SCORE >= 40 AND WEPOS_SUM_SCORE <= 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JUNG , SUM(CASE WHEN B.WEPOS_SUM_SCORE >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SANG , COUNT(*) AS SUM FROM AYD330 A, (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID, EVL_DT, WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO, WEPOS_SUM_SCORE FROM AYD500 WHERE 1=1 AND EVL_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) B WHERE A.FLAG_YN = 'Y' AND A.WEPOS_SCLAS_SN = '1' AND A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO = B.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO(+) GROUP BY A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO, A.WEPOS_PTTRN_NM ORDER BY A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectWeposInspStatsDetailList2 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO , A.WEPOS_PTTRN_NM AS FCTR , SUM(CASE WHEN B.WEPOS_SUM_SCORE <= 39 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HA , SUM(CASE WHEN B.WEPOS_SUM_SCORE >= 40 AND WEPOS_SUM_SCORE <= 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JUNG , SUM(CASE WHEN B.WEPOS_SUM_SCORE >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SANG , COUNT(*) AS SUM FROM AYD330 A, (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID, EVL_DT, WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO, WEPOS_SUM_SCORE FROM AYD500 WHERE 1=1 AND EVL_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) B WHERE A.FLAG_YN = 'Y' AND A.WEPOS_SCLAS_SN = '2' AND A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO = B.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO(+) GROUP BY A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO, A.WEPOS_PTTRN_NM ORDER BY A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO

/* isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.ConQuestionStatsMapper.selectWeposInspStatsDetailResultList05 - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT WEPS_RESULT_SN AS WEPS_RESULT_SN , WRTR_ID AS WRTR_ID , ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD , GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD , SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(WEPOS_SUM_CN,'e','정열성'),'i','그룹지향성'),'o','외향성'),'s','실리성') AS WEPOS_SUM_CN , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'e','정열성'),'i','그룹지향성'),'o','외향성'),'s','실리성') AS WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM , TO_CHAR(WRT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND WRT_DT BETWEEN #{STDT} AND #{EDDT} AND TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} ORDER BY WEPS_RESULT_SN DESC

SELECT '상담복지센터' AS WORDS ,COUNT(*) AS CCNT ,'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM ,1 AS SQNCE FROM AYA120 AA --위기상담_개인 WHERE 1=1
AND AA.YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD IN ('1', '2') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')+0.9999 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY 'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT '가족' AS WORDS ,COUNT(*) AS CCNT ,'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM ,2 AS SQNCE FROM AYA120 AA --위기상담_개인 WHERE 1=1
AND AA.FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD IN ('1','2') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')+0.9999 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY 'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT '일시보호소,쉼터' AS WORDS ,COUNT(*) AS CCNT ,'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM ,3 AS SQNCE FROM AYA120 AA --위기상담_개인 WHERE 1=1
AND AA.DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD IN ('1','2') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')+0.9999 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY 'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT '112,119등(긴급구조)' AS WORDS ,COUNT(*) AS CCNT ,'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM ,4 AS SQNCE FROM AYA120 AA --위기상담_개인 WHERE 1=1
AND AA.EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD IN ('1','2') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')+0.9999 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY 'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT '교사등지도자' AS WORDS ,COUNT(*) AS CCNT ,'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM ,5 AS SQNCE FROM AYA120 AA --위기상담_개인 WHERE 1=1
AND AA.LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD IN ('1','2') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')+0.9999 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY 'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT '기타전문기관' AS WORDS ,COUNT(*) AS CCNT ,'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YYYYMM ,6 AS SQNCE FROM AYA120 AA --위기상담_개인 WHERE 1=1
AND AA.ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD IN ('1','2') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')+0.9999 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY 'A'||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM')
